mapper.sql: JOIN CMM_CODE type_code ON type_code.CMM_CD = inquiry.CST_INQ_TYPE_CD JOIN CMM_CODE status_code ON status_code.CMM_CD = inquiry.CST_INQ_STATUS_CD

inquiry.CST_INQ_SN AS inquirySn, inquiry.CST_INQ_TYPE_CD AS inquiryTypeCode, type_code.CMM_NM AS inquiryTypeName, inquiry.CST_INQ_STATUS_CD AS statusCode, status_code.CMM_NM AS statusName, inquiry.CST_INQ_TTL AS title, inquiry.CST_INQ_REG_DT AS registeredAt, inquiry.CST_INQ_UPDT_DT AS updatedAt, inquiry.CST_INQ_ANS_DT AS answeredAt

inquiry.CST_INQ_SN AS inquirySn, inquiry.USR_SN AS userSn, inquiry.CST_INQ_TYPE_CD AS inquiryTypeCode, type_code.CMM_NM AS inquiryTypeName, inquiry.CST_INQ_STATUS_CD AS statusCode, status_code.CMM_NM AS statusName, inquiry.CST_INQ_TTL AS title, inquiry.CST_INQ_PROC_USR_SN AS processorUserSn, inquiry.CST_INQ_REG_DT AS registeredAt, inquiry.CST_INQ_UPDT_DT AS updatedAt, inquiry.CST_INQ_ANS_DT AS answeredAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CUSTOMER_INQUIRY ( USR_SN, CST_INQ_TYPE_CD, CST_INQ_STATUS_CD, CST_INQ_TTL, CST_INQ_CN, CST_INQ_REG_ID, CST_INQ_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{userSn}, #{typeCode}, #{statusCode}, #{title}, #{content}, #{registeredBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CUSTOMER_INQUIRY SET CST_INQ_TTL = #{title}, CST_INQ_CN = #{content}, CST_INQ_UPDT_ID = #{actorId}, CST_INQ_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE CST_INQ_SN = #{inquirySn} AND USR_SN = #{userSn} AND CST_INQ_STATUS_CD = 'INQC0007' AND CST_INQ_PROC_USR_SN IS NULL AND CST_INQ_ANS_CN IS NULL AND CST_INQ_ANS_DT IS NULL AND CST_INQ_USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.select:
SELECT inquiry.CST_INQ_SN AS inquirySn, inquiry.CST_INQ_TYPE_CD AS inquiryTypeCode, type_code.CMM_NM AS inquiryTypeName, inquiry.CST_INQ_STATUS_CD AS statusCode, status_code.CMM_NM AS statusName, inquiry.CST_INQ_TTL AS title, inquiry.CST_INQ_CN AS content, inquiry.CST_INQ_ANS_CN AS answer, inquiry.CST_INQ_REG_DT AS registeredAt, inquiry.CST_INQ_UPDT_DT AS updatedAt, inquiry.CST_INQ_ANS_DT AS answeredAt FROM CUSTOMER_INQUIRY inquiry
WHERE inquiry.CST_INQ_SN = #{inquirySn} AND inquiry.USR_SN = #{userSn} AND inquiry.CST_INQ_USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT inquiry.CST_INQ_SN AS inquirySn, inquiry.USR_SN AS userSn, inquiry.CST_INQ_TYPE_CD AS inquiryTypeCode, type_code.CMM_NM AS inquiryTypeName, inquiry.CST_INQ_STATUS_CD AS statusCode, status_code.CMM_NM AS statusName, inquiry.CST_INQ_TTL AS title, inquiry.CST_INQ_CN AS content, inquiry.CST_INQ_PROC_USR_SN AS processorUserSn, inquiry.CST_INQ_ANS_CN AS answer, inquiry.CST_INQ_REG_DT AS registeredAt, inquiry.CST_INQ_UPDT_DT AS updatedAt, inquiry.CST_INQ_ANS_DT AS answeredAt FROM CUSTOMER_INQUIRY inquiry
WHERE inquiry.CST_INQ_SN = #{inquirySn} AND inquiry.CST_INQ_USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE CUSTOMER_INQUIRY SET CST_INQ_STATUS_CD = #{processingStatusCode}, CST_INQ_PROC_USR_SN = #{adminUserSn}, CST_INQ_UPDT_ID = #{actorId}, CST_INQ_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE CST_INQ_SN = #{inquirySn} AND CST_INQ_STATUS_CD = #{receivedStatusCode} AND CST_INQ_PROC_USR_SN IS NULL AND CST_INQ_ANS_CN IS NULL AND CST_INQ_ANS_DT IS NULL AND CST_INQ_USE_YN = 'Y'

UPDATE CUSTOMER_INQUIRY SET CST_INQ_STATUS_CD = #{answeredStatusCode}, CST_INQ_ANS_CN = #{answer}, CST_INQ_ANS_DT = NOW(), CST_INQ_UPDT_ID = #{actorId}, CST_INQ_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE CST_INQ_SN = #{inquirySn} AND CST_INQ_STATUS_CD = #{processingStatusCode} AND CST_INQ_PROC_USR_SN = #{adminUserSn} AND CST_INQ_ANS_CN IS NULL AND CST_INQ_ANS_DT IS NULL AND CST_INQ_USE_YN = 'Y'
